sourceScope: Project-qualified Korean display localization only for Hero IDs explicitly declared in the source manifest.

claims.heroEndpoints: Hero IDs are read from the existing canonical Hero identity owner; this slice creates no identity or population claim.
claims.sourceChineseDisplayKey: For original 7 Heroes, ConfigDataHeroInfo.Name is retained directly; for the 93 extension Heroes, the pinned identity-authority hero-name-master nameCn row is used as the Chinese display key. The latter was not independently re-parsed against the raw ConfigData JSON in this work.
claims.koreanDisplayLabel: The supplied project localization reference directly provides the Korean display label selected by exact Chinese-key equality.

limitations: Official Korean-server provenance and the reference source version are unverified.
The source list is a display-localization reference, not Hero identity, population, release-status, or relation authority.
The exact Chinese-key comparison is used only to select a Korean display label for an already identified Hero ID.

fieldMapping.nameCn: ConfigData Chinese display-name key as represented by the pinned Hero name master
